outcome: Number of women who received QBL assessment
Number of morbid cases (>= 4 packed red blood cell units)
cohort: 4413 women who underwent childbirth (qualified cases) from a single center
finding: Implementation of a train-the-trainer QBL program as part of a hemorrhage safety bundle was associated with an increase in QBL assessment, increased blood transfusion rates, and a decrease in the number of morbid cases.
